description: This file defines API routes for managing products in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products, utilizing SQLAlchemy for database interactions and dependency injection for security and database sessions.

classes.name: UserFriendlyError
classes.description: TypedDict class for user-friendly error messages with optional fields 'message', 'code', and 'details'.

methods.name: list_products_endpoint( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), active_only: bool = Query(default=True, description="Only active products"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list active products, returns a list of ProductRead models, with error handling for database issues.

methods.name: get_product_endpoint(product_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches details of a single product by ID, with error handling for product not found and database errors.

methods.name: create_product_endpoint(payload: ProductCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new product (admin only) from the provided ProductCreate payload.

methods.name: update_product_endpoint(product_id: int, payload: ProductUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID with provided ProductUpdate data (admin only).

methods.name: delete_product_endpoint(product_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID (admin only), returning 204 No Content on success.
